name: Arcis Skill Archive
description: Agent-ready capabilities for the Arcis treasury. Any AI agent or LLM can use these to earn yield, manage idle capital, borrow against reputation, and discover vaults on Base mainnet.

skills.name: Earn Yield on Idle USDC
skills.summary: Deposit idle USDC into the Arcis vault and earn a variable APY via Aave V3. Withdraw instantly anytime.
skills.when_to_use: The agent holds USDC sitting idle between jobs or payments — including USDC earned via x402 and other agent-payment rails. Turns dead stablecoin balances into yield.

skills.name: Auto-Manage Agent Treasury
skills.summary: Continuously sweep idle USDC above a reserve floor into yield, and pull funds back when the agent needs to spend. Set-and-forget.
skills.when_to_use: The agent earns and spends USDC over time and wants idle balances to always be productive without manual action.

skills.name: Check Treasury Position
skills.summary: Read an agent's vault position, current value, and the live vault APY.
skills.when_to_use: The agent or its operator wants to know how much is deposited and what it's earning.

skills.name: Borrow Against Position and Reputation
skills.summary: Open a credit line against a vault position, at rates set by ERC-8004 reputation tier. Access liquidity without withdrawing.
skills.when_to_use: The agent needs spending liquidity but wants to keep its yield-earning position intact.

skills.name: Discover Agent-Token Vaults
skills.summary: List every agent-token vault in the Arcis factory registry, or find the vault for a specific token.
skills.when_to_use: The agent wants to find or use a vault for a specific agent token (e.g. $CUSTOS), or enumerate all available vaults.

skills.name: Deposit an Agent Token
skills.summary: Deposit any agent token into its Arcis vault for custody and to use as credit collateral. Receive a raTOKEN receipt.
skills.when_to_use: The agent holds a token that has an Arcis vault and wants custody plus the ability to borrow against it.
